//: THE 5C QUESTION SET. This file is the source of truth for the questionnaire.
The questions below are PLACEHOLDERS. The coaching team replaces them; nothing in
the UI, the controllers or the storage layer needs to change when they do.
* 'key' is the stable identifier that answers are stored against. Changing a key
orphans every answer already submitted for it. Change 'text' freely; change a
'key' only when you genuinely mean 'this is a different question'.
* Keys must be unique across the whole file, lower-case, and use hyphens.
* Every category needs at least one question. The intended shape is 5 x 5 = 25.
* 'reversed' marks a negatively worded statement. It is scored as (6 - value) so
that a high score always means 'good'. Do not flip the scale in the form to
* 'textAboutPlayer' is optional. Leave it null and every role sees 'text'. Fill it
in and coaches and guardians see that wording instead, while the player still
sees 'text'. Both are answered on the same scale and stored the same way.
The app validates this file at startup and refuses to start with a clear error if
it is malformed, so a typo shows up immediately instead of halfway through a round.

categories.name: Commitment
categories.description: Drive, and the ability to keep working at long-term development.

questions.text: I keep working on my development even when progress is slow.
I arrive prepared for training and matches.
I have goals for my own development that I work towards.
I lose motivation when things do not go my way.
I put in the extra work that development requires.

categories.name: Communication
categories.description: Communication with team-mates, opponents, the coaching staff and the support team.

questions.text: I speak up to my team-mates during training and matches.
I can tell the coach when something is difficult.
I listen to feedback without becoming defensive.
I find it hard to make myself understood on the pitch.
I help team-mates by telling them what I see.

categories.name: Concentration
categories.description: Holding focus through a full session or match.

questions.text: I stay focused through a whole training session.
I get back into the match quickly after a mistake.
I am easily distracted by what happens around me.
I know what I am supposed to be paying attention to in a given situation.
I keep my focus through the closing minutes of a match.

categories.name: Control
categories.description: Self-control and emotional regulation under pressure.

questions.text: I stay calm when the match gets tight.
I handle decisions I disagree with without losing my head.
I get angry with myself when I make a mistake.
I keep my body language steady when things go against me.
I can settle myself down when I notice I am getting stressed.

categories.name: Confidence
categories.description: Self-belief and trust in one's own ability in training and matches.

questions.text: I trust my own ability in a match.
I dare to try new things in training even if I might fail.
I am afraid of making mistakes in front of the others on the team.
I believe I will reach the goals I have set for myself.
I ask for the ball in situations that matter.
